title: Election report of Indiana 1994 (general election statistics), scanned by the Indiana State Library

offices.clerk-of-the-supreme-court: Clerk of the Supreme and Appellate Courts

note: Leaves are ContentDM item ids (PDF pages 22 to 24 of the report, printed 36 to 40): Secretary of State and State Treasurer start on 2983, Treasurer continues and Auditor starts on 2984, Auditor continues and the Clerk starts on 2985. The ContentDM OCR holds names and numbers as separate column blocks (a county list, then one block per candidate), with slips such as 7,01.3 and L227, so vision, tied to the printed TOTALS row of each column. All four office slugs exist as `us.office` ids `{slug}:IN`.
